about.subtitle: Profile
about.title: Introduction
about.content: Financial analyst and financial management tools designer, I operate at the intersection of finance and technology to structure, automate and make data actionable. Graduated in accounting and management, then trained in data analysis and artificial intelligence, I have evolved into a role focused on financial transformation, business intelligence and performance consulting. My approach combines understanding of financial challenges, data mastery and technological vision to support companies in modernizing their management, automating their processes and making their analyses more reliable. I have designed and deployed dynamic financial models, interactive dashboards and automated tracking systems that enable decision-makers to better understand, anticipate and manage their business. I use tools such as advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, VBA, SQL, Python, Power Automate and n8n to develop custom solutions that combine precision, speed and decision-making value.

snagz.title: Financial Automation & Data | BI
points: Implementation and automation of financial processes (automated P&L at ~90%, margin calculations, provisions).
Structuring a profitability tracking system by project/sale and revenue forecasting.
ERP restructuring and automation of accounting flows via Power Query / SQL.
Deployment of financial and extra-financial Power BI dashboards for operational and strategic management.
Results: automated view of margins on 5 main activities; complete structuring of direct and indirect costs; cost reduction plan managed via dashboards.

datascientest.title: Data Analyst Training
points: Data analysis and management with Python via Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PySpark for preprocessing and dataframe manipulation.
Visualization with Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, ggplot, Bokeh for statistical and interactive charts.
Machine learning with Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, LightGBM for prediction and modeling.
Databases: SQL, normalization, structuring with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite for optimized data management.

lowCode.subtitle: Custom Application Development
lowCode.title: Low-Code Solutions
lowCode.content: I design and deliver custom business applications using modern technologies (React, Python, FastAPI). My approach is centered on understanding your specific needs, building robust and scalable tools, and ensuring your satisfaction at every stage — from initial specification through deployment and beyond. Every project is a commitment: I remain available to iterate, support, and evolve the solution until it fully meets your requirements.
lowCode.footer: From business intelligence tools to full-stack web applications, I transform concrete business challenges into production-ready solutions. My clients benefit from a structured, transparent delivery process with regular updates, and I remain engaged post-delivery to ensure the tools perform as expected in real-world use.
